## Checklist

- [ ] Normative spec changes link to an issue
- [ ] Schemas, examples and spec text agree (`pytest conformance` passes)
- [ ] Reference implementation tests pass, if touched (`pytest python/tests`)
- [ ] Breaking protocol changes are called out, with a new version and URI
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
